properties.name: READ 2026-10-01: Grok Build's plugin format accepts Claude Code's layout and `.claude-plugin/` manifests and marketplaces, so one plugin folder in Claude's format serves both; plugins deliver files not binaries; the MCP server's working directory is unstated in both
properties.source: ~/.grok/docs/user-guide/09-plugins.md (Grok Build user guide, file dated 2026-10-01) lines 60, 185, 376, 400-438; Claude Code 2.1.287 `claude plugin --help` and the official marketplace checkout at ~/.claude/plugins/marketplaces/claude-plugins-official (315 plugins)
properties.statement:
GROK BUILD's guide says:
- A plugin is a folder with any of skills/, commands/, agents/, hooks/hooks.json, .mcp.json and .lsp.json. plugin.json is optional; without it the standard folders are discovered (lines 400-411).
- Grok "also accepts `.grok-plugin/plugin.json` and the `.claude-plugin/` equivalents" (line 185), discovers `.claude/plugins/` equivalents (line 417), sets the CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT/CLAUDE_PLUGIN_DATA aliases for plugin hooks (line 438), and reads marketplace sources from ~/.claude/settings.json (line 60).
- Marketplaces are a git repo or local folder with a marketplace.json index. Install with `grok plugin install <name> --trust`. `grok plugin validate` and `grok plugin tag` exist.
- Hooks and MCP servers stay inactive until the plugin is trusted. Plugins are off until enabled. ~/.grok/plugins/ is auto-trusted.
- "plugins deliver files, not runtimes or native binaries" (lines 376, 413).

CLAUDE CODE 2.1.287:
- `.claude-plugin/plugin.json` (name, description, author, version) plus `.mcp.json`, commands/, skills/, agents/ and hooks/hooks.json, with `${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT}`;
- marketplaces via `.claude-plugin/marketplace.json`;
- `claude plugin init/validate/tag/eval/install/update`.

CONSEQUENCE FOR req:reflow2s-kit-is-packaged-to-the-agent-plugins-specification:
- One reflow2 plugin folder in Claude's format reaches Claude Code AND Grok Build, which today take two installer paths (reflow2_install.py's `claude mcp add`, reflow2_init.py's .grok/config.toml).
- The Agent Plugins spec's root plugin.json + mcp.json can sit beside it for the spec's other implementers. Each tool reads its own manifest; Claude Code was measured ignoring the spec's.
- The reflow2-mcp binary still comes from install.sh, and the plugin's .mcp.json runs it from PATH.

STILL UNKNOWN, IN BOTH GUIDES: the working directory a plugin's MCP server starts in. reflow2 finds its design relative to it (fact:the-agent-plugins-requirement-is-unstarted-and-a-plugin-launched-reflow2-would-look-for-its-design-in-the-plugin-2026-10-01). A scratch plugin per tool answers it.

2026-10-01, LATER — the working directory both guides leave unstated was measured: both start a plugin's MCP server in the project folder (fact:claude-code-and-grok-start-a-plugins-mcp-server-in-the-project-folder-2026-10-01). What this reading says about the two guides stays true, so it stays open.
